proposals.name: STRAID — Space-Time Risk-Allocated braID planner
proposals.one_liner: A global planner that enumerates space-time braid classes (the in-time passing-side vector of the ego world-curve around each predicted pedestrian world-tube), prices every class with the main-line certified collision-risk field under a per-agent budget traded across agents (Σ α_i ≤ ε_pred), and returns the min-risk braid + continuous leaf with an anytime risk-gap certificate. So "stuck" is rewritten as "minimum achievable certified risk," and the function is provably total because a certified yield / over-the-top-climb braid is always a feasible incumbent with a finite risk bound.
proposals.spine: hybrid — the load-bearing novelty is the GLOBAL space-time-braid + risk-budget layer; MINCO is only a swappable continuous leaf underneath it (per task framing: scope = the whole global planner, MINCO = 可换叶子). All four claimed guarantees live in the global layer, not the leaf, so the leaf could be replaced by iLQR/DDP without touching them.
proposals.core_mechanism:
Step 0 — Risk-field fusion (interface to the main line). Collapse the safety layer's three perception branches into ONE time-indexed risk field: (a) per-agent conformal tube r_i(t;α_i)=q(α_i)·ρ_i(t), where spending more budget (smaller α_i) inflates the tube — risk-as-resource; (b) deterministic occlusion shadow r_occ+v_max·t; (c) body-floor clearance gate. The budget is tradeable: Σ_i α_i ≤ ε_pred, plus fixed ε_cls from the classification-set gate (human∈set → that agent's tube becomes a HARD constraint). This is CRISP-ST's tradeable budget wired straight to the main paper's P(hit)=ε_cls+ε_pred decomposition; the planner's objective scalar IS the certificate number.

Step 1 — Space-time braid signature (the dynamic-domain coordinate). Reuse the front-end objects: heat-A* (graph_search.hpp) for WHERE/side, ST-graph DP (st_graph.hpp) for WHEN, space-time corridor (spacetime_corridor.hpp — already analytic predict(t) SIPP cuboid×time-window) as the convex stay-in-box conditioner. Lift to space-time: for the ego curve γ(t)=(p(t),t) vs each pedestrian's predicted world-tube T_i (a thickened world-line in (x,y)+t), compute a braid/winding signature β(γ) = the vector of in-time passing sides (front=+ / behind=− / left / right) of γ around every T_i. This is a SPACE-TIME invariant (front-vs-behind a MOVING tube), not the static H-signature the repo currently uses — exactly the object that repairs the A1 static-homotopy blind spot.

Step 2 — Conflict-driven braid-lattice search (CDB) with risk pricing. Keep a priority queue of nodes (braid β, budget α, leaf incumbent). Seed from the heat-A* braid AND from the certified recovery braid (Step 3). Expand cheapest-risk-first: run the MINCO leaf constrained to β at allocation α; if a space-time conflict survives (some tube cannot be cleared at the current α_i), BRANCH lazily two ways — (i) re-allocate budget: give the conflicting agent more α_i, deflate the others via a single dual price λ (CRISP-ST deflation = a (time vs risk) Pareto sweep, branch points = homotopy switches); or (ii) flip the braid bit for that agent (pass the other side / re-time front-vs-behind), spawning a child class. Only conflicts spawn children, so the (otherwise combinatorial) braid set is enumerated lazily — the right primitive because the repo has NO braid enumerator.

Step 3 — Min-risk total-function rewrite + anytime dual gap. The objective is min total certified risk (a single scalar) over the dynamics + budget simplex. The certified recovery braid (recovery.hpp yield extended with the vertical-climb-to-controlled-invariant-set RTA backup) is ALWAYS resident as an incumbent with a finite, pre-computed risk R_safe. Hence the feasible set is never empty: at worst STRAID returns R_safe; it never returns "infeasible." A convex relaxation (budget LP + GCS-style corridor relaxation, REGENT) supplies a lower bound R_lb on achievable risk → an anytime gap [R_incumbent − R_lb] ≥ 0; stop at the deadline with a certified-suboptimality incumbent (computation-invariant safety, inheriting anytime_feasible.hpp's deadline-stop).

Step 4 — O(M) spectral branch router (M6, repurposed). When a conflict survives, the leaf's reduced-Hessian (independent symmetric-indefinite LDLᵀ on the (q,T)-reduced KKT, reusing the already-paid banded MINCO factorization for Hessian-vector products) yields λ_min in O(M). Its inertia routes the CDB branch: topological stall (F1) → flip braid (Step 2-ii); numerical stall (F2/F3/F5, λ_min>0 but ill-conditioned) → re-solve / re-budget in-braid (Step 2-i); DYN_INFEASIBLE → re-time via ST-graph. This turns "which branch" from a heuristic into an O(M) spectral decision — the only place the second-order machine is load-bearing.

Step 5 — Continuous-time soundness (B5). Each MINCO segment is a polynomial; certify the braid-constrained clearance to each conformal tube r_i(t;α_i) BETWEEN samples via a Bernstein-hull / HOCBF forward-invariance certificate (FI-MINCO). This makes the per-segment risk a continuous-time bound, closing the sampled-constraint transcription gap that would otherwise make the certificate a lie between knots.
genuinely_new_residual: The single fusion OBJECT: a space-time braid class that CARRIES a conformal collision-risk budget. Strip the parts and each is prior art (braid signatures = Mavrogiannis/Knepper; conformal tubes = main line / 2511.18170; risk allocation = IRA/RCSP), but nobody has made the homotopy/braid class the index over which a per-agent conformal budget α_i is traded and topologically branched. Conformal×space-time today is a TUBE (a metric inflation); STRAID makes it a TOPOLOGY-priced resource (which side, at what α_i).

Risk-as-resource COUPLED to topology branching: the same budget α_i both inflates the tube AND, when it cannot be cleared, triggers a braid flip (Step 2). The dual price λ that deflates budgets and the homotopy-switch branch points are the SAME breakpoints — a (time vs certified-risk) Pareto front whose kinks are homotopy switches. This unification (one λ sweep = both budget reallocation and topology selection) is the new mechanism.

The O(M) reduced-Hessian inertia (λ_min) used as a GLOBAL BRANCH SELECTOR, not just an in-leaf diagnostic: spectral classification topological-vs-numerical-vs-dynamic deciding braid-flip vs re-budget vs re-time. In the seeds this router only existed inside one MINCO solve; promoting it to drive conflict-driven global branching is new as a coupling.

Totality as a THEOREM via a certified recovery braid as permanent incumbent: 'the planner is a total function returning a certified-risk-bounded space-time braid' — existence is constructive, not an engineering fallback. The min-risk rewrite + always-resident R_safe incumbent means 'no solution' is impossible by construction.

Dynamic-domain completeness keyed to the SPACE-TIME braid (not static H-signature): completeness is stated over the finite set of realizable in-time passing-side classes against the predicted tubes — the correct completeness notion in a moving-pedestrian domain, which is the explicit repair of the A1 hole.
collision_targets: arXiv 2511.18170 (conformal × space-time tube) — the closest prior on the conformal×spacetime axis; Wave3 must show STRAID adds braid-class-indexed budget TRADING + topological branching, not just a probabilistic tube.

T-MPC++ (de Groot et al., 2024, T-RO) — topology-driven PARALLEL MPC in the dynamic pedestrian domain; the single most dangerous collision. Must show (a) space-time braid/winding as an explicit certified invariant vs their parallel-topology heuristic, (b) certified conformal risk budget, (c) anytime global risk gap — none of which T-MPC++ has.

Mavrogiannis & Knepper space-time braids for multi-agent navigation (and topological-braids robotics line) — the braid PRIMITIVE is theirs; MUST cite. Delta to verify: ego-drone vs NON-reactive pedestrians = winding-vector not full Artin braid; our braid carries a conformal risk budget + MINCO leaf + anytime dual gap, in a single-ego (not joint multi-robot) setting.

ST-GCS (2503.00583), GCS* (2407.08848), INSATxGCS (2410.08909) — space-time / global-optimality GCS planners. Must show conflict-driven braid + tradeable risk vs their convex-restriction global search; the REGENT 'GCS branch-and-price / dual-price oracle' lower bound overlaps these most.

IRA (Ono–Williams risk allocation) and dual RCSP (arXiv 2302.13115) — risk-budget-as-resource prior art. Must show the SPACE-TIME-braid coupling + anytime dual gap, not just chance-constraint risk allocation along a fixed homotopy.
ST-RRT* (2203.02176) — space-time sampling completeness; contrast braid-class certified min-risk + totality vs probabilistic completeness.
EGO-Planner-v2 / Bubble Planner / TRUST-Planner — topology+parallel local optimization (the D1 'this is just EGO-v2' attack); show the global certified layer above the leaf.
Trautman–Krause (freezing robot) — the 'never stuck' / min-risk motivation; position the totality theorem against the freezing-robot impossibility (we guarantee existence+safety, not goal-liveness).
proposals.dynamic_domain_soundness: SOUND in the dynamic domain — this is the design's whole point and the A1 repair — but with three honest qualifications. (1) The invariant is computed in SPACE-TIME (passing front-vs-behind a MOVING world-tube), so it is non-trivial in exactly the regime where the repo's current static H-signature (plan_minco.hpp passing_side, types.hpp:673 minco_use_topology) is blind. (2) Rigor of the word "braid": for a SINGLE ego vs N NON-reactive pedestrians the object is precisely the WINDING/passing-side vector of γ in (free-space minus pedestrian world-tubes), i.e. a relative-homotopy invariant — NOT a full Artin braid group element (the pedestrians do not braid with each other under ego control). "Braid" is branding inherited from the SKEIN/TANGLE seeds; the provable claim is winding-vector completeness, and I will state it that way. (3) Dimensional subtlety that actually strengthens coherence: around a 1-D obstacle world-line in full 3-D, homotopy is trivial (you can always go over the top), so the winding lattice is the HORIZONTAL (x,y)+t projection with pedestrians as extruded vertical cylinders — there it is non-trivial. The genuinely-3-D over-the-top class is exactly the recovery/vertical-climb braid, which is therefore not an afterthought but the canonical escape class that anchors totality (there is always the climb class with finite risk). Soundness is conditional and inherits the main line's named assumptions: sound against the PREDICTED CONFORMAL tubes (prediction error absorbed into r_i(t;α_i) so a class collision-free vs the inflated tube is collision-free w.p. ≥ 1−α_i), within commit horizon < tau_trust (0.75 s), under pedestrian speed bound + non-reactive (performativity → limitations). What the braid adds over the tube alone: the tube says "stay 0.9 m away"; the braid says "and commit to a consistent side," which is what prevents the oscillate-into-freezing failure the tube cannot see.
proposals.no_stuck_mechanism: Two layers, deliberately different strengths. STRONG (provable, constructive): TOTALITY. The certified recovery braid (yield + vertical-climb to a controlled-invariant safe set) is always a resident incumbent with a finite, pre-computed risk R_safe; the returned plan is argmin risk over a feasible set that ALWAYS contains it. Therefore STRAID is a total function — it never returns "infeasible/no solution," and its output always carries a certified risk ≤ R_safe. This is "构造上永不卡死 = 永有认证安全回退" made into a theorem, reusing recovery.hpp + anytime_feasible.hpp's deadline-stop (stop anywhere = still feasible). WEAK (honest): LIVENESS. Min-risk rewrite means that even with no zero-risk plan the drone moves along the lowest-risk braid instead of freezing, and the λ-deflation Pareto front lets the RTA pick a liveness-preserving (time vs risk) point. But we do NOT claim goal-completion in adversarial/dense crowds — that is the freezing-robot impossibility (Trautman–Krause). So: existence + bounded-risk + forward-progress-when-safe = guaranteed; reaching the goal = not guaranteed. Stating it this asymmetrically is itself the defense against over-claim.
provable_claims: TOTALITY: For any input (state, predicted conformal tubes, budget ε, deadline), STRAID returns a trajectory whose certified collision risk ≤ R_safe, because the recovery braid is always a feasible incumbent. Sub-lemma to discharge: the vertical-climb-to-hover backup provably reaches a controlled-invariant safe set, inheriting branch-② occlusion handling for the climbed-into (unseen) space + an explicit height budget.

RISK SOUNDNESS (continuous-time): If STRAID returns braid β with allocation {α_i}, Σα_i ≤ ε_pred, and the leaf satisfies the per-segment Bernstein/HOCBF clearance vs each r_i(t;α_i), then P(collision with agent i over the episode) ≤ α_i (+ its ε_cls share), and by union over the H agents P(any collision) ≤ ε_cls + ε_pred = ε. New part vs main line: the Bernstein per-segment certificate upgrades sampled to continuous-time (closes B5); the rest inherits the sup-over-horizon conformal score.

DYNAMIC-DOMAIN COMPLETENESS (conditional): Within tau_trust, against the predicted tubes, the conflict-driven enumeration is complete over the finite set of realizable space-time winding classes on the lattice — if a tube-collision-free class exists STRAID finds one, else it certifies none exists and returns the min-risk class. Conditional on lattice resolution + the winding-vector (not full-braid) formalization; completeness is over winding classes, not all of continuous free space.

ANYTIME GAP VALIDITY: the convex relaxation value R_lb (budget LP + GCS corridor relaxation) is a valid lower bound on min achievable certified risk over all braids, so [R_incumbent − R_lb] ≥ 0 is a sound suboptimality certificate at every deadline. (Flag: validity is provable, TIGHTNESS is not — see weakest link.)

ROUTER SOUNDNESS (O(M)): the reduced-Hessian inertia/λ_min correctly separates a topological stall (no in-braid descent reduces risk → braid flip is necessary) from a numerical stall (in-braid descent exists). Provable direction: if λ_min certifies a strict in-braid local min above the conflict threshold, then re-solving in-braid cannot clear it and a flip/re-time is required — so the router never withholds a needed branch. (Converse — that a flip always helps — is heuristic; state only the sound direction.)
proposals.engine_leaf: O(M) second-order MINCO, used as a swappable leaf. Concretely the existing min-jerk MINCO with DIRECT (q,T) decision variables (T is a real box-constrained variable under L-BFGS-B, minco_cost_grad.hpp:192 — NOT exp(τ); second-order math is derived in direct-T coordinates) and the banded M(T)c=b system already factorized to recover c. Second order = reduced-Hessian Hessian-vector products in O(M) by REUSING that already-paid banded factorization (Pearlmutter/GGN over the flat-output map), with an INDEPENDENT symmetric-indefinite Bunch-Kaufman/LDLᵀ on the reduced Hessian — it must not reuse M(T)'s LU because M(T) is asymmetric (solve_adjoint uses the transpose LU). At current M ≤ 12 the reduced Hessian is ≤ 72×72 dense PartialPivLU at μs scale; switch to banded LDLᵀ only once M grows past the strict-O(M) threshold. Honest scoping (D2): the second-order machine (GGN, Pearlmutter Hvp, banded preconditioner, RTI/C-GMRES) is classic — its value here is "组合 + structure insight," not a new primitive, and it is load-bearing ONLY as the O(M) spectral branch router (Step 4). STRAID's contribution sits ABOVE the leaf, so the leaf is replaceable (iLQR/DDP) and D2 threatens only the leaf's separate sale, not the planner.
proposals.repo_integration: A HYBRID front-end ABOVE the existing leaf, wired INTO the main-line safety layer. REUSE (already in cpp/include/sando_cpp): graph_search.hpp (heat-A* guide), st_graph.hpp (ST-graph WHEN/DP), spacetime_corridor.hpp (analytic predict(t) SIPP cuboid×time-window = the convex conditioner and the per-tube collision test), anytime_feasible.hpp (deadline-stop anytime-feasible leaf; line 65 already has a single time-aware topology seed to generalize), recovery.hpp (yield_target → becomes the certified recovery braid; needs the vertical-climb z≠0 extension already flagged in spec §3, current yield is z=0 horizontal-only), reach_avoid.hpp (clearance scoring), minco_cost_grad.hpp (leaf cost/grad). GENUINELY NEW C++ (repo has NO braid enumerator — only generate_detour_seeds ±u/±v multistart + a single static passing_side H-sig, ≤6 obstacles): the space-time winding-signature computer, the conflict-driven braid-lattice priority queue, the single-λ budget-deflation Pareto sweep, the anytime risk lower bound, and the reduced-Hessian λ_min router (M6). MAIN-LINE WIRING: consumes the DynTraj label-set ABI (types.hpp:346 DynTraj currently has is_agent/id but NO class field — the 2-3 day new build in spec §5) and the conformal radius hook (q_conformal scalar already plumbed OptParams→ALM; the per-agent α_i budget needs that scalar promoted to a vector). The planner's min-risk scalar IS the safety layer's P(hit) bound, so planner and certificate share one number — this makes the side-paper planner the exact carrier the main paper §3 already wants ("class-gated hardness × tube × RTA recursive feasibility"). CAVEATS: per spec §4 修正2 the real D435i loop has no dynamic-obstacle channel yet → STRAID's dynamic story is Isaac-quantitative + real-drone-qualitative (same posture as the main line); and per CLAUDE.md / plan §0 三铁律 this is SIDE-PAPER work to be built AFTER 9/15, must not front-run the main paper.
proposals.weakest_link: The ANYTIME RISK LOWER BOUND → global-optimality claim (provable claim 4). This is the exact M7 failure mode: under a budget-simplex relaxation the LP can almost always drive R_lb ≈ 0 (relaxed allocation can pretend "enough budget on the right agent → risk→0"), so the "anytime GLOBAL optimality gap" risks being vacuous and the contribution degrades to "anytime best-first over braids with a sound-but-loose gap." The robust trio (TOTALITY, continuous-time RISK SOUNDNESS, DYNAMIC-DOMAIN winding-completeness) survives this, but the global-optimality sales pitch does not — and it is also the seam of the D1 framing attack ("this is just EGO-v2 / T-MPC++ topology search with a risk relabel"). Adjacent second-weakest: the braid-vs-prior-art collision (Mavrogiannis braids + T-MPC++ topology in the dynamic domain) — a positioning risk Wave3 must defuse by foregrounding the conformal-budget-carrying winding + totality, NOT the braid primitive itself. Recommended framing: lead with totality + dynamic soundness + main-line coupling; demote the global gap to anytime best-effort.

proposals.name: FULCRUM (Flat-Unified Lever: Curvature-Routed Un-stuck MINCO)
proposals.one_liner: A second-order MINCO inner solve whose reduced-Hessian INERTIA is read online as a single O(M) observable that (a) drives true Newton/Gauss-Newton steps via a matrix-free Hessian-vector product reusing the already-paid banded LU of M(T), (b) mechanistically classifies WHY the solve stalled (numerical / saddle / topological-trap / dynamically-infeasible) and routes the matching escape, with FLECHE (numerical-algebraic-geometry critical-point enumeration) as the certified topological-escape operator and FI-MINCO (per-segment Bernstein-HOCBF) as the continuous-time safety accept-gate — wrapped in a total-function fallback ladder so the planner never returns "no output" and never executes a between-sample collision; completeness/optimality honestly scoped to per-replan quasi-static cells, safety certificate dynamic-sound.
proposals.core_mechanism:
Center of gravity is MINCO-internal (the reduced-Hessian engine + certificates); it escalates to the global/topology layer ONLY when a cell is certified dead. Inner solve is over x=[q (3(M-1)), T(M)] in the existing direct-T L-BFGS-B coordinates (minco_cost_grad.hpp:191-192), with c=M(T)^-1 b flat-eliminated.

STEP 1 — PRYBAR (O(M) second-order engine). The reduced objective F(q,T) (exactly the cost in minco_cost_grad.hpp) has a DENSE reduced Hessian (flat-elimination couples all segments), which is why the whole field uses first-order L-BFGS. Insight: a Hessian-vector product nabla^2 F . v is O(M) because (i) directional derivatives of c through M^-1 are two triangular back-subs on the SINGLE banded LU already computed in MinjerkTraj::solve() (line 159) — forward solve + the existing solve_adjoint (line 261), no refactor; (ii) the dM/dT and new d2M/dT2 contractions are segment-local (exactly like dM_dT_times_c, line 269). Take Gauss-Newton/Newton steps via MINRES on this matrix-free Hvp, replacing L-BFGS.

STEP 2 — M6 inertia router. Each outer iter compute inertia (n+,n0,n-) and lambda_min of the reduced Hessian. M(T) is ASYMMETRIC (solve_adjoint transposes its LU), so the inertia CANNOT reuse M(T)'s LU — it needs an INDEPENDENT symmetric factorization: at current scale assemble the (4M-3)-dim reduced Hessian from 4M-3 Hvps + Bunch-Kaufman LDLT (M=12 -> ~45x45, microseconds); Lanczos on the Hvp when scale triggers. Combine lambda_min sign + active-Jacobian rank + FI-MINCO residual to classify: CONVERGED(definite,KKT small,FI passes->accept) / NUMERICAL(definite but ALM penalty ill-conditioned->rescale rho, banded-precondition, continue) / SADDLE(lambda_min<0->take Lanczos negative-curvature descent escape) / TOPO-TRAP(definite but no feasible descent direction reduces violation->FLECHE) / DYN_INFEASIBLE(FI cert irreducibly fails->ST-graph time-reparam or escalate).

STEP 3 — FLECHE certified escape. On TOPO-TRAP freeze active set A and T; KKT stationarity is then polynomial in q; homotopy-continuation enumerates ALL real critical points in the cell. Either return a feasible stationary point local Newton missed (certified escape) OR certify the cell has none -> sound "this homotopy class is locally infeasible" certificate -> request a topology/seed change from the global layer (generate_detour_seeds, plan_minco.hpp:299; future ST-braid seed). Runs off the critical path with its own deadline; timeout -> recovery ladder.

STEP 4 — FI-MINCO accept-gate. Convert each degree-5 segment to Bernstein (control_points(), line 197 + control-point wall-clock times, line 211 — already golden), form the HOCBF forward-invariance polynomial h>=0, hdot+alpha(h)>=0 against analytically-predicted moving spheres (SphereObstacle::predict), certify nonnegativity by Bernstein-coefficient sign with <=r de Casteljau subdivisions. Replaces the sampled K=200 check_feasibility (plan_minco.hpp:394) -> closes the between-sample B5 gap, dynamic-sound, O(M).

STEP 5 — total-function ladder. Each deadline tick returns a certified-safe incumbent: FI-certified optimum -> else last certified-feasible incumbent (anytime_feasible.hpp) -> else FLECHE-routed yield (recovery.hpp yield_target, max min-clearance, validated freeze -0.29 -> +2.97) -> else vertical climb/hover. Every rung carries a continuous-time clearance>=0 certificate; the router's typed reason selects the rung.
genuinely_new_residual: STRUCTURAL IDENTITY (headline): the MINCO flat-elimination reduced Hessian admits an O(M) matrix-free Hessian-vector product by REUSING the single banded LU of the ASYMMETRIC M(T) (one forward + one adjoint triangular solve via the existing solve_adjoint) plus segment-local dM/dT, d2M/dT2 contractions — making SOLVER-LEVEL second-order MINCO (Newton + inertia) tractable, which the prior-art (universally first-order L-BFGS on (q,T)) leaves blank. Non-obvious because M(T)'s asymmetry forbids reusing its LU for the SYMMETRIC inertia, forcing an independent Bunch-Kaufman/Lanczos. Honest: GGN + Pearlmutter Hvp + banded preconditioning are each classic primitives; the new thing is the exploitation of THIS structure, not a new primitive.

INERTIA-AS-ROUTER (the only lever both new and rigorous): reading the reduced-Hessian inertia (lambda_min sign + active-Jacobian rank + continuous-time residual) as an ONLINE typed DIAGNOSIS of the stall mode {numerical / saddle / topological-trap / dyn-infeasible} that dispatches a structurally-different recovery — turning 'the solver failed' into a certified reason at O(M). Distinct from IPOPT/SQP inertia CORRECTION (they add deltaI to force a descent step; we READ the same spectrum to route to a topology change / FLECHE / yield, not to regularize). No prior planner reads its own reduced-Hessian spectrum to decide WHY it is stuck.

FLECHE AS A CERTIFIED TOPOLOGICAL-INFEASIBILITY DECISION for the flat-elimination cell: complete real-root enumeration of the polynomial KKT system yields a genuine certificate 'this homotopy class has no feasible stationary point', used as the rigorous trigger to ABANDON a cell instead of timing out. New as an escape OPERATOR keyed by the inertia router (homotopy-continuation itself is classic).

TOTAL-FUNCTION COMPOSITION with a per-tick continuous-time safety certificate where the fallback rung is SELECTED BY the same inertia/feasibility diagnosis — 'constructively never stuck' with a typed reason at every rung (not just a generic anytime incumbent).

FI-MINCO wiring (supporting): per-segment Bernstein-HOCBF forward-invariance certificate reusing the existing C2B/control_points machinery as BOTH the accept-gate AND the DYN_INFEASIBLE router input — closing the sampled-collision B5 gap, dynamic-sound, O(M). Bernstein+HOCBF are classic; the new bit is the wiring to the router + accept-gate on already-present golden code.

proposals.dynamic_domain_soundness: Honest split, NOT a braid. SAFETY is dynamic-sound: FI-MINCO certifies the executed degree-5 segments against the ANALYTICALLY-predicted moving spheres continuously over [0,Th] — the signed distance to a moving sphere along a polynomial segment is itself polynomial in tau once the prediction is fixed, so the Bernstein convex-hull bound (existing C2B/control_points) gives a between-sample-tight certificate; this is exactly the dynamic guarantee the main-line safety paper needs. COMPLETENESS/OPTIMALITY is deliberately scoped to per-replan quasi-static cells: within one replan the prediction is frozen and the active set fixed, so the local KKT subproblem FLECHE enumerates is a STATIC polynomial system; M6's TOPO-TRAP detection and FLECHE's 'no feasible critical point' certificate are sound only for that frozen cell. I explicitly DECLINE the static-H-signature-in-a-dynamic-domain claim (the A1 trap) and DECLINE the braid generalization (that is the other candidates' bet) — instead I keep each cell quasi-static using the repo's space-time scaffolding (st_graph.hpp speed DP for WHEN, spacetime_corridor.hpp cuboid+time-window for WHERE) and rely on receding-horizon replanning for the dynamics. Net: 'safety certificate dynamic-sound; completeness/optimality airtight only per quasi-static replan' — the honest, defensible position the task asked for.
proposals.no_stuck_mechanism: Three-part guarantee, with explicitly different strengths. (1) NEVER-UNSAFE (hard): every accepted trajectory passes the FI-MINCO continuous-time clearance>=0 certificate against the predicted hard set; this is a proof, not a sampled check. (2) NEVER-NO-OUTPUT (hard / total function): the deadline-wrapped ladder always returns SOMETHING carrying a continuous-time clearance certificate — FI-certified optimum, else last certified-feasible incumbent (anytime_feasible.hpp, R.feasible honest flag), else FLECHE-routed yield (recovery.hpp), else climb/hover; the router's four classes plus DYN_INFEASIBLE exhaustively partition the non-converged KKT space so no unhandled state exists. (3) NEVER-FREEZE (empirical only): on a certified topological trap the system actively yields to MAXIMIZE min-clearance (recovery.hpp, measured freeze -0.29 -> yield +2.97/+3.70) rather than braking to a stale plan. STRENGTH HONESTY: parts (1) and (2) are formal; part (3) is empirically superior active yield, NOT a formal liveness/deadlock-freedom proof — in an adversarial dense crowd, global liveness is the Trautman-Krause freezing problem and I do not claim to solve it. So 'never stuck' = certified-safe + certified-output total function + actively-yielding, NOT formal liveness.
provable_claims: P1 (O(M) Hvp): given the single LU of M(T), one reduced-Hessian-vector product nabla^2 F(q,T).v costs O(M b^2) time / O(M b) memory (b=11 fixed bandwidth) with NO refactorization — 2 triangular solves on the existing LU + segment-local dM/dT, d2M/dT2 contractions; hence k extremal eigenpairs of the (4M-3)-dim reduced Hessian cost O(kM) via Lanczos.

P2 (inertia soundness / no false saddle): the Bunch-Kaufman LDLT inertia of the assembled reduced Hessian equals (Sylvester's law) the inertia of nabla^2 F; in particular lambda_min<0 <=> there exists a negative-curvature direction d with d^T nabla^2 F d < 0, which with a line search strictly decreases F — so a SADDLE classification always yields a real escape step.

P3 (router exhaustiveness): at any non-converged feasible-side iterate exactly one of {gradient nonzero along a feasible direction (NUMERICAL) / indefinite reduced Hessian (SADDLE) / definite Hessian but no feasible descent direction reduces violation (TOPO-TRAP) / FI-MINCO continuous-time certificate fails (DYN_INFEASIBLE)} holds; each maps to a defined action, so the planner never reaches an unhandled state (basis of the total-function claim).

P4 (FLECHE completeness, quasi-static): for fixed active set A and fixed T the flat-elimination KKT stationarity system is polynomial in q of total degree bounded by an explicit d(M,|A|); homotopy continuation returns all real solutions, so 'no feasible stationary point' is a SOUND certificate of infeasibility of the local NLP restricted to (A,T). Scope: per cell, frozen prediction.

P5 (FI-MINCO continuous-time soundness, dynamic): if every segment's HOCBF Bernstein coefficients are >=0 after <=r de Casteljau subdivisions, then h(x(t))>=0 for all t in [0,T_i] continuously, INCLUDING against analytically-predicted moving spheres, so the accepted trajectory has provably zero between-sample violation; cost O(M r).

P6 (total function with safety certificate): the planner returns, at any deadline, a trajectory carrying a continuous-time clearance>=0 certificate w.r.t. the predicted hard set; the fallback ladder is exhaustive (P3) and each rung is individually certified, so the output map is total and safety-certified. (Reuses recovery.hpp clearance-max + anytime_feasible incumbent.)

P7 (D2 quantification, honest negative): inner decision dim 4M-3 (~45 at M=12, M(T) 6M=72) vs an iLQR/DDP state-control lift (n_x+n_u)K; per-Newton-step cost O(M b^2 k_Lanczos) vs DDP O(K n^3); the second-order advantage rests on (q,T)-only differential-flat + banded structure — and is asymptotic (materializes at large M; at M<=12 the dense inertia is already microseconds).
proposals.engine_leaf: O(M) matrix-free SECOND-ORDER MINCO. Gauss-Newton/Newton step via MINRES on the reduced-Hessian Hvp, where the Hvp reuses the SINGLE banded PartialPivLU of the asymmetric M(T) (minjerk_traj.hpp:159) for c-elimination directional derivatives (forward solve + existing solve_adjoint at line 261) plus segment-local dM/dT (existing dM_dT_times_c, line 269) and a new d2M/dT2. Inertia/spectrum for the M6 router comes from an INDEPENDENT symmetric factorization (Bunch-Kaufman LDLT of the assembled (4M-3)-dim reduced Hessian at current scale; Lanczos on the Hvp once the banded-LDLT scale trigger fires) — never the M(T) LU. This is the deployability win over the universal first-order L-BFGS-B leaf, and the same machine emits the routing observable, so second-order convergence and stall-diagnosis share one engine.

proposals.weakest_link: Positioning mismatch between the headline and the deployable claim. The HEADLINE novelty is 'O(M) solver-level second-order MINCO', but its efficiency only materializes at large M, while this application runs M<=12 (reduced Hessian ~45x45) where a dense Bunch-Kaufman inertia is already microseconds — so at deployment scale the O(M) efficiency is real math but irrelevant, leaving the genuinely-load-bearing contribution as INERTIA-AS-ROUTER, which is sound but a smaller idea AND partly heuristic: the router's TOPO-TRAP class is an inference ('definite Hessian + no feasible descent direction') that is only PROVEN by a subsequent FLECHE call — between confirmations the routing can transiently misclassify (cost = a wasted FLECHE/rescale, not a safety loss, since P6 total-function holds). Compounding this, the optimality/completeness CONTRIBUTION leans on FLECHE, whose numerical-algebraic-geometry enumeration is the slow, heavy-dependency operator (acknowledged soft spot) and the one most exposed to a Wave3 prior-art hit (homotopy-continuation critical-point enumeration in planning). Mitigation keeps SAFETY intact (FLECHE is off the critical path with its own deadline -> recovery), but the OPTIMALITY/EFFICIENCY story is the attackable link; the defensible, airtight core to lead with is 'inertia-routed certified-escape + dynamic-sound FI-MINCO total function', treating O(M) second-order as the enabling engine rather than the headline claim.

proposals.one_liner: 一个"永不返回⊥"的全函数规划器:外层在 space-time braid 格上以"认证碰撞风险"单标量做 anytime best-first(min-risk 改写,绝不报无解);中层把 M6 reduced-Hessian 在线惯性证书推广为【跨层卡死类型路由器】——同一份 O(M) LDLᵀ 既驱动二阶 MINCO 叶子、又给出惯性 λ_min 用来判定"数值鞍点(F2/3/5)/真堵此 braid(F1)/动力学不可行(DYN)/全局真堵(min-risk>ε)"并分派对应逃逸;叶子是 O(M) 矩阵-free 截断牛顿 MINCO + 连续时间 Bernstein 凸包安全证书;真堵时落到 recovery.hpp 认证最大间隙让行,故 codomain 恒为 (轨迹, 风险证书)。

proposals.core_mechanism:
每个 receding-horizon replan 周期(anytime 预算 T_budget):
(1) 预测+建风险场:主线 conformal 预测器出每个行人 world-tube;融合 per-agent conformal tube 半径 r_i(q_conformal) + 确定性遮挡阴影 r_occ+v_max·t + body-clearance floor,得单一风险场 R(p,t);braid b 的风险 = sup-over-horizon(整段 max,匹配 spec 的时间整形分数)碰撞概率。
(2) 枚举 braid(有界 K 个,这是真·工程新点):heat-A* 横向 side 选择(graph_search.hpp + passing_side)× ST-graph 时序"先过/后过 gap"选择(st_graph.hpp 的 station-time DP)的笛卡尔组合 = braid word;按风险下界 best-first 排进优先队列(注:time-anchor 目标使长度型 LB≈0,故是 best-first 排序而非紧 B&B 间隙)。
(3) 风险预算分配:ε=0.1(=ε_cls 0.02+ε_pred 0.08)作可交易资源 Σα_i≤ε,单一对偶 λ 给 per-agent tube 半径 r_i(α_i)放气;一次 λ-sweep 出 (时间 vs 认证风险) Pareto,断点=braid/active-set 切换。
(4) 弹出最优 braid → 跑 O(M) 二阶 MINCO 叶子(per-class ALM:人=硬凸包,墙=软 EGO 场)+ 连续时间 Bernstein 证书,吃掉剩余预算。
(5) 路由器(中央):读 (叶子 reduced-Hessian 惯性 λ_min via Bunch-Kaufman LDLᵀ、叶子认证风险 ρ、绑定项诊断) → 分类:λ_min<0/近零 ⇒ 数值卡 F2/3/5(沿负曲率特征向量做认证逃逸步,或小子问题 FLÈCHE 临界点枚举,不换 braid);λ_min>0 且 ρ>ε ⇒ 此 braid 真堵 F1(换下一个 braid);动力学 hinge 项主导 dT 且 T-块惯性不定 ⇒ DYN_INFEASIBLE(用 ST-graph 重定时/膨胀 T,不动 q)。
(6) anytime:始终保留 best certified-feasible incumbent(anytime_feasible.hpp);预算到 → ρ≤ε 返回 incumbent;否则返回全局 min-risk 轨迹;若连 min-risk>ε(braid 队列耗尽=全局真堵)→ 返回 recovery.hpp yield_target(最大化对预测集 min-clearance)或垂直爬升 backup,并附 ρ。
(7) 独立 RTA 监视节点核验已提交段 [0,replan_dt] 对证书是否成立,违则触发 fallback。
关键正交坍缩:让叶子变快的 O(M) reduced-Hessian LDLᵀ,恰好就是路由器诊断它的惯性来源——同一对象两用。
genuinely_new_residual: 核心残差(全场唯一既新又严):把 reduced-Hessian 在线惯性 λ_min 提升为【跨层卡死类型路由器】——用同一份 O(M) LDLᵀ 判定'换 braid vs 逃鞍点 vs 重定时 vs 让行'。现有 trust-region 只在求解器内部用曲率;没人用叶子求解器的惯性去仲裁'拓扑/数值/动力学/真堵'四类并分派恢复。这是 M6 从'MINCO 内诊断'到'全局四类路由'的推广。

proposals.no_stuck_mechanism:
"永不卡死"= 全函数语义(P1),分强度三档:
[强] 永不返回 ⊥ / 永不报'无解' / 永不冻结在 stale plan:recovery.hpp yield_target 候选集含'stay'故恒非空,bench_recovery 实测 freeze min_human −0.29 → yield +2.97/+3.70;anytime 循环恒有 incumbent(alm_solve 已有 deadline_s + best_feasible_x)。输出永远是 (轨迹, 风险证书)。
[强/可证] 数值卡死被可证打破:reduced-Hessian 惯性 n_−≥1 ⇒ 当前点必非局部极小 ⇒ 负曲率方向是严格下降方向(P3),故求解器不可能被永久困在鞍点。这是唯一'卡死'被严格消除的一环。
[中] 真正"前进/逃死锁"不保证:braid 集有界,对抗性人群可逼迫永久让行(freezing robot)。这是诚实天花板——我们是 safety-complete(永不撞、恒有认证让行),非 liveness-complete。
provable_claims: P1 全函数性(never-⊥):对任意输入 (x0,O,Pred,T_budget>0),TRIAGE 在 ≤T_budget+O(M) 内终止并返回 (τ, ρ∈[0,1]),恒非 ⊥(recovery 候选集含 stay 故恒非空);若 x0 存在不变安全动作(悬停/爬升)则已提交前缀 τ|[0,replan_dt] 无碰撞。
P2 连续时间 soundness(关闭 B5):对五次 MINCO 每段 s,取其 [0,T_s] 上的 5 阶 Bernstein 系数 β_s;若 ∀s,min_k clearance(β_s,k)≥0(凸包下界对预测 tube),则 min_{t∈[0,T_tot]} clearance(τ(t))≥0——精确连续时间,非采样点。

P3 诊断 soundness(单边严格):设叶子终点 reduced (q,T) Hessian 的 Bunch-Kaufman 惯性 (n_+,n_−,n_0)。(a) n_−≥1 ⇒ 该点非局部极小,负主元对应特征向量为严格下降方向,故曲率逃逸步在足够小步长严格降目标(数值卡检测=sound)。(b) n_−=n_0=0 且 ρ>ε ⇒ 是不安全的严格局部极小 → 换 braid(启发,不证该类全局极小亦不安全)。
P4 风险预算 Pareto 单调:固定 braid b,映射 α(Σα_i≤ε)↦ 在 tube 半径 r_i(α_i) 下的最短时可行 τ 单调——增大 α_i 缩 tube_i ⇒ 可行集增 ⇒ 最短时不增;故单次 λ-sweep 描出分段单调 (时间,风险) 前沿,断点恰为 active-set/braid 切换(逐 braid 单调,全局分段)。

P5 O(M) 二阶:叶子每次截断牛顿/GGN 迭代 = O(M)(带宽 9 的前向 M(T)c=b + 转置邻接 Mᵀλ=rhs + 每段 6×6 GGN 块 + 4M−3 维 reduced-Hessian 带状 LDLᵀ),对比 dense (q,T) Hessian 的 O(M³)。条件:须把现 dense PartialPivLU 换成带状分解(实现步骤,尚未做;M≤12 时 72×72 现为 μs 级)。D2:变量数 4M−3 vs iLQR/DDP 的 O(horizon·(n+m)²),微分平坦+带状是胜过 DDP 的杠杆,Wave4 须量化每步 flops。
P6 安全⊥拓扑(A1 中和器):P1+P2 与 braid 索引无关,braid 仅选'找哪个局部极小';故 A1(静态完备性)只攻 braid 搜索的 liveness/最优性,攻不到安全——任意 braid 集下输出恒为 ρ≤ε 认证安全或带 ρ 的认证最大间隙让行。

proposals.one_liner: 一个 Lagrangian「风险价格」λ,在风险加权的时空 SIPP/RCSP 图上扫一遍,同时 (i) 把共享的 conformal 撞人风险预算 ε 当可交易资源分配给各被检测 agent(per-agent tube 分位 r_i=Q_{1-α_i},Σα_i≤ε_pred)、(ii) 选定时空辫(braid)类——于是它的断点恰是「抢行/让行」passing-order 切换,它的轨迹是一条带认证的 (makespan, 撞人概率上界) Pareto 前沿,其 λ→∞ 端点是永远可用的 recovery braid;故 planner 是全函数 world→(轨迹, 认证风险),永不输出「无解」,且 per-episode 安全性对 braid 枚举完备性无依赖。

proposals.core_mechanism:
步骤化:
(1) 感知融成单一时变风险场:每个检测+分类 agent i 给一条 conformal tube,半径 r_i(α_i)=Q_{1-α_i} 套在预测世界线 x̂_i(t) 周围(human∈label-set→硬约束,永不被预算放气);遮挡阴影 r_occ+v_max·t(分支②确定性,0 预算);body-floor depth→occupancy + 0.4m 重规划膨胀(分支③确定性,0 预算)。Σ_i α_i≤ε_pred 是唯一可交易量。
(2) 建风险加权时空图:扩 st_graph.hpp 的(s 沿 heat-A* 向导,t)单调-in-s DAG;把「二值 blocked」换成「穿过 agent i 的 (s,t) 格付一笔 conformal 风险增量,该增量随分给 i 的分位 α_i 增大而单调下降」——多花预算给 i = 缩 i 的 tube = 放开该格。spacetime_corridor.hpp 给每格 safe-interval [t_l,t_u]。
(3) 对预算对偶化:L(path,α;λ)=makespan(path)+λ(Σ_i risk_i(path,α_i)−ε)。固定 λ 的内问题 = 资源定价最短路(RCSP),由现有单调-in-s DP 一次解出,DP 在每个 mover 世界线处的「先过/后过」决策【就是】braid 类、同时定 local α_i。
(4) λ 连续统延拓:λ 从 0(最快/最险)单调升;d(λ) 是凹的分段线性;每个断点 λ_k 处 argmin 路径在某次交汇的 passing 决策翻转 = 一次认证的 braid 跃迁。incumbents 连成非支配的 (makespan, risk) Pareto 阶梯。
(5) 叶子精化:把选中 braid 的 safe-interval cuboids(corridor_cuboids 钩子)+ per-agent r_i(α_i)(per-agent q_conformal 向量)喂给带状 MINCO 叶子(minco_cost_grad.hpp,L-BFGS-B 直接 (q,T));anytime_feasible 截止即停、停在哪都可行。
(6) 逐点两侧认证:(上界/安全)对精化后的五次多项式段做 Bernstein 段内多项式下界,认证整段(非采样点)都在每条 r_i tube 之外(关 B5)→ P(撞 i)≤ε_cls,i+ε_pred,i,union≤ε;(下界/最优性)弱对偶 d(λ) 给「该 makespan 下最小风险」的下界 → anytime 间隙。
(7) 全函数端点:λ→∞ 选 recovery braid(recovery.hpp yield + z-climb backup 进遮挡-安全不变集),恒有定义 → 永不 ∅;「卡住」= 前沿高-λ/高-risk 那端的一个有限标量。
(8) 叶子级恢复路由(降级的③):叶子 stall 时,reduced-Hessian 惯性 λ_min(O(M),复用已付的带状 M(T) 分解)+ ALM 乘子增长 → 路由到 {拓扑不可行→换下一条 braid / 数值→reseed / 鞍点→扰动 / 动力学不可行→放 T}。

proposals.dynamic_domain_soundness: Sound——用【时空 braid】当搜索坐标(不是静态 homotopy),直击 A1。关键:【不主张】braid 枚举完备(repo 现无枚举器,只有单 passing-side + pass_behind + ≤5 detour seeds;SKEIN/TANGLE 仅种子)。解耦立场:(a) per-episode 安全 P(撞)≤ε 对枚举完备性【无依赖】——证书在选定五次多项式路径上事后用 conformal tube + Bernstein 连续时间界算;(b) 最优性/anytime 间隙仅相对【已枚举 braid 格】成立,除非对偶松弛能在自由空间连续统上给下界。故 A1 被双重化解:(i) 用 braid 而非静态同伦,(ii) 拒绝 A1 称『不可能』的那个完备性主张。B5(采样-gap,af_min_clr K=50 已确认)由 Bernstein 段内多项式界关闭。Caveat:braid 等价类只在【非反应行人】假设下良定义(已是命名 limitation);反应 agent 会中途换类 → 靠 commit horizon<tau_trust 的逐回合重解吸收,不承诺 mission 级。
proposals.no_stuck_mechanism: 强形式 = 全函数。风险价格延拓恒有 λ→∞ 端点 = recovery braid:recovery.hpp yield_target(候选集 argmax min-clearance,因 stay∈候选集故可证 ≥ freeze)+ z-climb backup 进遮挡阴影(r_occ+v_max·t)安全不变集。只要存在一个静态安全位形(body-clearance≥c_min 的悬停点),planner 返回 (recovery 轨迹, 认证风险) 而非 ∅。「卡住」被具体化为前沿高-risk 端的一个有限标量,永不是 failure。强度边界(诚实):保证是「永不返回无解 / 永不冻结在 stale plan 上」,【不是】「总能向目标推进」——对抗人群里的 liveness 不主张(否则撞 freezing-robot 不可能性);死锁 = 一条无低风险推进选项的高风险前沿,被如实暴露为 min-risk 的 hold/yield。
provable_claims: P1(全函数/recovery 端点):设遮挡-安全不变集 S_safe(t0)(z-climb+brake 维持 body-clearance≥c_min,worst-case 阴影 r_occ+v_max·t)非空,则延拓有定义的 λ→∞ 端点、其认证风险有限 → world→(轨迹,认证风险) 是全映射,永不 ∅。

P2(per-episode union 安全,braid 无关):在命名假设下(格内 Mondrian 交换性、行人 v_max、commit horizon<tau_trust、Isaac 机载渲染在 tracker 输出上标定),被执行轨迹 π 对每条检测 track i:P(π 撞 i 整段)≤ε_cls,i+ε_pred,i,其中 ε_pred,i 由 r_i=Q_{1-α_i} 实现、Σα_i≤ε_pred;union 得 P(撞任一)≤ε。【对枚举了几条 braid 无关】(主线定理 + 新增:{α_i} 是对偶扫描选出的)。
P3(连续时间 soundness,关 B5):每个 MINCO 五次段,把 (r_i(t)+r_body)^2 − ‖π(t)−x̂_i(t)‖^2 转 Bernstein 基,全系数≤0 ⟺ 整段(非采样)在 i 的 tube 外。代价 O(M·deg)。把采样 clearance 升级为 sound 连续时间 clearance。

P4(弱对偶 anytime 下界,格相对):令 r*(τ)=已枚举 braid 格 B 内 makespan≤τ 的最小认证风险;d(λ)=min_{π∈relax}[risk+λ(makespan−τ)] 满足 d(λ)≤r*(τ),∀λ≥0(弱对偶)→ anytime 下界;incumbent 给上界;差 = 相对 B 的合法 anytime 最优性间隙(诚实:非连续统,除非松弛在自由空间取 min)。
P5(Pareto/断点结构):λ 从 0 单调升,d(λ) 凹、分段线性,断点集 {λ_k} 有限(图有限);每个 λ_k 处某次交汇 passing 决策翻转 = 认证 braid 跃迁;incumbents 的 (makespan,risk) 非支配(Pareto 阶梯)。
P6(recovery 单调性):yield_target 选中动作 min-clearance ≥ freeze(因 stay∈候选集),故 recovery 端点至少与持有 stale plan 一样安全;配遮挡阴影维持不变集(实测 freeze −0.29→yield +2.97/+3.70)。

consolidated.name: STRIDE — Space-Time Risk-priced, Inertia-routed Dynamic-Escape planner (merges STRAID + TRIAGE + TARIFF)
consolidated.one_liner: A total-function global planner: one Lagrangian risk-price λ sweeps the main-line conformal collision budget (Σα_i ≤ ε_pred; human∈label-set = un-deflatable hard) across detected agents on a risk-weighted space-time (station,time) RCSP DAG, and the SAME price selects the space-time passing-order (winding/"braid") class — its breakpoints ARE the pass-front-vs-behind switches — yielding a native (makespan, certified-risk) Pareto frontier whose λ→∞ endpoint is the certified recovery class, so the map world→(trajectory, certified-risk∈[0,1]) is total and never returns ⊥. An O(M) reduced-Hessian inertia (independent LDLᵀ) routes leaf stalls into {flip-winding / escape-saddle / re-time / yield}, and a quintic-Bernstein per-segment certificate makes the risk bound continuous-time. Crucially safety is DECOUPLED from winding-enumeration completeness (winding only picks WHICH local min; it is provably outside the safety bound) — the honest repair of the static-homotopy/A1 blind spot. The planner's min-risk scalar IS the safety layer's P(hit)≤ε number.
genuinely_new_residual: Conformal QUANTILE as a tradeable dual resource welded to the main-line ε-certificate (from TARIFF): α_i indexes the distribution-free calibrated tube radius r_i=Q_{1-α_i} (NOT a Gaussian chance-constraint probability mass à la IRA), so λ has units 'makespan per unit conformal quantile' and the planner objective IS the certificate. Strip the parts (RCSP/Lagrangian dual, IRA allocation, conformal tubes) and each is classic; new = wiring conformal calibration into RCSP resource pricing ON the main-line P(hit) decomposition.

The price IS the topology selector and its breakpoints are certified (merge of TARIFF+STRAID): one λ simultaneously (a) reallocates per-agent budget and (b) selects the space-time winding class; the λ-continuation breakpoints λ_k ARE the pass-front-vs-behind switches, so a (time,certified-risk) Pareto STAIRCASE is the planner's native output, not a single trajectory. Budget reallocation and topology flip are one mechanism, not two.

Safety/optimality DECOUPLED from winding-enumeration completeness — the A1 neutralizer (TRIAGE): the executed trajectory's risk certificate is computed post-hoc on the chosen quintic path via conformal tube + Bernstein hull at trajectory-local time, INDEPENDENT of how many winding classes were enumerated; incomplete enumeration costs only the anytime gap, never safety.

Min-risk TOTAL-FUNCTION semantics anchored at a certified recovery class (STRAID+TRIAGE+TARIFF): codomain always (trajectory, ρ); 'stuck' redefined as the finite scalar min-risk>ε (NOT a solver flag), at which the λ→∞ recovery class (max-min-clearance yield + spec-§3 z-climb-to-invariant-set) is returned with its bound. Existence constructive (recovery candidate set contains 'stay' ⇒ never empty).

O(M) reduced-Hessian inertia λ_min promoted to a CROSS-LAYER stall-type router (TRIAGE generalization of M6 — the search's 'only lever both new AND rigorous'): the same independent symmetric-indefinite LDLᵀ that gives the leaf its second-order step yields the inertia that classifies {numerical-saddle / topologically-trapped-in-this-winding / dynamically-infeasible} and dispatches {escape / flip-class / re-time}. Distinct from IPOPT/SQP inertia CORRECTION (they add δI to regularize; we READ the spectrum to arbitrate the branch).

(honest, weaker) The space-time winding index is BUILT from existing primitives (heat-A* lateral sides × ST-graph pass-order DP), giving a dynamic-domain topology index with NO new GVD/Yen/H-signature/braid combinatorial engine — pragmatic but bounded-K, not complete.
